source_reference.title: Absolute Batman (DC All In, 2024-present)
influences: Frank Miller (Dark Knight Returns bulk and weight)
Mike Mignola (spot blacks and silhouette language)
Sean Murphy (urban grit and architectural linework)

overall_aesthetic.genre_cues: neo-noir superhero, gothic industrial, post-apocalyptic urban

figure.body_type: massively hulking powerlifter build; trapezoidal silhouette dominated by shoulders and chest

proportions.head_to_body_ratio: 1:7 (head deliberately small relative to enlarged torso and shoulders)
proportions.neck: thick, nearly invisible between cowl and trapezius
proportions.waist: narrow relative to chest to accentuate V-taper
proportions.legs: tree-trunk thick, planted wide, emphasizing weight

figure.posture: grounded, heavy, low center of gravity; almost always in a hero stance or menacing stride

cowl.shape: angular, faceted, short sharply-pointed bat ears that lean slightly forward
cowl.eye_slits: pure white, blank, no pupils, slightly narrowed into hostile slants
cowl.jawline: exposed, square, stoic; often with 5 o'clock shadow or gritted teeth
cowl.material_feel: rigid composite, matte black with subtle blue tonal gradient on highlights

chest_emblem.design: segmented, wraparound armored bat-symbol that functions like a chest plate
chest_emblem.pattern: grid of square/rectangular plates forming a stylized bat across pectorals
chest_emblem.color: matte black plates with cool dark blue facets, never glossy
chest_emblem.note: this is the single most recognizable element - the bat is engineered, not painted

shoulders_and_arms.spikes: asymmetrical cluster of jagged metal spikes erupting from the left shoulder and trapezius, scrap-built, varying lengths
shoulders_and_arms.gauntlets: horizontally ribbed/striped vambraces with banded segmentation, 6-8 ridges per forearm
shoulders_and_arms.fin_blades: optional curved scalloped fin-blades on the outer forearm

cape.length: long, reaches to ankles, often pools on floor
cape.edges: jagged, tattered, torn into irregular triangular tails
cape.interior_color: deep black with subtle blue wash on folds
cape.movement: heavy, weighted, rarely billowing - falls like chainmail
cape.attachment: clasped at shoulders, sometimes appearing stitched or bolted

torso_and_belt.belt: thick industrial strap with large rectangular utility pouches, military/construction-grade buckle
torso_and_belt.waist_area: black trunks over tactical pants, no bright colors

legs_and_boots.pants: matte black tactical/workwear with subtle paneling

weapon.primary: oversized double-headed firefighter axe or sledgehammer with wrapped grip
weapon.handling: carried one-handed, dragged low, grip pose suggests immense weight
weapon.secondary: batarangs shaped like curved claw blades, elongated and serrated

line_work.weight: thick, variable, confident; outer contours heaviest, interior details thinner
line_work.ink_approach: brush-inked feel with organic thick-to-thin modulation

hatching.style: angular parallel hatching, occasional crosshatch on deep shadows
hatching.density: used sparingly - Dragotta prefers spot black over rendering
hatching.direction: follows form contour; verticals dominate on cityscapes

spot_blacks.usage: aggressive, sculptural, covering 40-60% of character areas
spot_blacks.purpose: define silhouette, carve form, create abstract negative space

line_work.texture_marks: rough deckle edges, occasional drybrush scratches on cape and weapons
line_work.cleanliness: intentionally gritty and imperfect - never slick or vector-clean

color_palette.palette_logic: limited split-complementary - cool blues on character against warm ambers/magentas in backgrounds
color_palette.saturation: high chroma on environment, desaturated and tonal on the figure
color_palette.value_structure: low-key, 70% of frame sits in the bottom third of the value scale

lighting.key_light: offscreen high contrast, usually from above-back creating strong rim

rim_light.placement: along shoulder, cowl edge, cape contour

lighting.fill_light: minimal - shadows stay crushed and graphic
lighting.ambient: dominated by city glow (warm amber or cold purple), wraps environment not figure
lighting.atmospheric_perspective: heavy haze on distant buildings, glowing window grids bleed into sky
effects: color fringing where warm city meets cold character
subtle chromatic halation around light sources

camera_angles: extreme low angle / worm's eye (hero shot)
slight dutch tilt for action interiors
composition.framing: Batman occupies 60-80% of vertical frame, head near top third

background_architecture.content: towering skyscrapers, window grids, construction scaffolding, gothic spires
background_architecture.treatment: rendered as luminous silhouettes, never competing with figure
background_architecture.perspective: aggressive one-point or two-point perspective with converging verticals

composition.negative_space: deep blacks used to isolate figure and force silhouette reading
composition.horizon_line: kept low, often below frame, to enlarge the figure

rendering_techniques.form_modeling: planar shading - blocks of color describing facets rather than smooth gradients
rendering_techniques.highlights: hard-edged specular blocks on metal and leather, not soft blends
rendering_techniques.shadows: graphic shapes, often abstracted into geometric chunks
rendering_techniques.transitions: minimal midtones - mostly two-tone modeling (dark base + rim accent)
rendering_techniques.texture: subtle halftone or stipple grain on backgrounds for print feel
rendering_techniques.print_feel: retains newsprint CMYK honesty - not over-polished digital

typography_and_cover_layout.logo_treatment: ABSOLUTE in thin caps above giant hand-drawn BATMAN wordmark
typography_and_cover_layout.batman_wordmark: bold cyan/teal sans, slightly bevelled, oversized, filling top quarter
typography_and_cover_layout.dc_bug: classic circular DC All In roundel top-right in cerulean
typography_and_cover_layout.credits: small stacked sans-serif caps bottom-right, white on black

generation_prompt_template.positive_prompt: Absolute Batman in the style of Nick Dragotta and Frank Martin, hulking brutalist powerlifter proportions, trapezoidal silhouette with exaggerated shoulders, segmented wraparound armored bat chest-plate made of matte black grid panels, asymmetrical jagged scrap-metal spikes erupting from left shoulder, short angular bat-ears cowl with blank white eye slits, horizontally ribbed steel gauntlets, long jagged tattered cape pooling at ankles, oversized double-headed firefighter axe dragged at his side, heavy tactical boots, extreme low-angle hero shot, standing atop Gotham rooftop, towering skyscrapers behind with glowing amber window grids, twilight magenta and dusk purple sky, cool cyan rim light on cowl and shoulders, desaturated steel blue figure against high-chroma warm city, heavy spot-black inking, thick confident brush lines, minimal hatching, planar shading, two-tone modeling, graphic shadow shapes, cinematic noir lighting, gritty print-era comic finish, monumental iconographic composition
generation_prompt_template.negative_prompt: slim build, athletic superhero proportions, smooth gradient rendering, soft airbrush shading, pastel palette, cheerful lighting, clean vector lines, anime style, chibi, photorealistic skin pores, glossy plastic armor, bright saturated primary colors on costume, yellow oval chest emblem, long cape billowing like flag, classic comics blue-gray costume, cartoon outlines, low contrast, daylight scene, sunny sky, white background

character.pose: planted low-stance hero pose, weight on back foot, axe dragging
character.facial_expression: stoic, gritted jaw, blank white eye slits narrowed
character.weapon: oversized wrapped-grip firefighter axe held one-handed

environment.atmosphere: humid urban haze, light bloom, subtle chromatic halation

camera.framing: full figure, head near top of frame, horizon below waist

lighting.rim: cyan edge along cowl, shoulder, cape
lighting.ambient: warm amber from city, cool purple from sky
lighting.shadow_style: crushed graphic blacks, no lifted shadows

color_direction.character: desaturated cool blues and inky blacks
color_direction.background: saturated warm amber contrasted with dusk purple

rendering.line: thick brush inks with variable weight
rendering.shading: planar two-tone, minimal hatching, spot blacks dominant
rendering.texture: subtle halftone grain, gritty print feel

do: keep the bat emblem as a segmented armor plate, never a flat painted symbol
include at least one set of asymmetrical scrap spikes on the left shoulder
use crushed blacks - shadows should feel graphic and sculptural
contrast cool desaturated figure against warm high-chroma Gotham
anchor the character with a low horizon and monumental framing
draw the cape jagged and heavy, never smooth or flowing like silk
give Batman a hand weapon (axe, hammer, or wrench) whenever plausible
dont: do not slim Batman into a classic athletic build
do not use the yellow oval chest emblem
do not render with smooth airbrush gradients
do not add bright primary color costume elements
do not light the scene in flat daylight
do not use clean vector outlines - keep lines organic and inked
do not place Batman in a symmetrical standing pose without weight shift

replication_checklist: Silhouette reads as Batman from 50 feet away via grid bat-plate and spikes
Eye slits are solid white and narrowed
Cape edges are jagged and tattered
Background is a glowing Gotham skyline
Spot blacks cover at least 40% of the figure
